title: Fuzzer: `Image.compress_from_channels` crashes Godot
body:

- 4.8.dev.custom_build (2c089e9bf)

### System information

### Steps to reproduce

Run this script:

```gdscript
extends Node

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	for i in get_children():
		i.queue_free()

	var temp_variable8182 = Image.new()
	temp_variable8182.crop(30, 23)
	temp_variable8182.generate_mipmaps(true)
	temp_variable8182.compress_from_channels(3, -79, -25)

	get_tree().quit()
```

Or use the attached `mrp.zip`:

```
godot --headless --path mrp/ Node.tscn
```
